policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.

DATASET_DIR.holds: the COCO-2014 5,000-caption validation subset (captions, reference images, latents)

MODEL_DIR.holds: the Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 fp16 checkpoint

policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python3 main.py --dataset "coco-1024" --dataset-path coco2014 --profile stable-diffusion-xl-pytorch --accuracy --model-path model/` with --dtype fp16 (the fp16 checkpoint), --device cuda and --scenario Offline over the 5,000 COCO-2014 captions in DATASET_DIR, then tools/accuracy_coco.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.torch cuda:: the value of `torch.cuda.is_available()` and the GPU names, written by the process that runs the model
